Tradiția vânătorii britanice a produs un: The tradition of British hunting has produced a refined dress code over centuries of practice. Every piece has a function. Every choice says something about the person wearing it.
Există puține țesături cu o poveste atât: Few fabrics have such an authentic story. Harris Tweed is handwoven in the homes of locals on the Outer Hebrides islands, Scotland, from pure virgin wool dyed and spun locally. Every length bears the authenticity stamp of the Harris Tweed Authority. Its durability is legendary — a Harris Tweed coat lasts decades, gains character with every wear, and improves over time.
O haină de vânătoare bine construită are: A well-built hunting coat has a few essential elements: shoulders with enough freedom of movement to raise the gun, a double or padded front for protection, large flap pockets for cartridges and small game, and a vented or split back that allows movement. The optimal length reaches mid-thigh. The traditional color is in earth tones, olive, brown, or heather.
Vânătoarea presupune ore petrecute afară: Hunting involves hours spent outdoors, with varying temperatures. The layering principle is simple: a thermal base layer, an intermediate wool or fleece layer, and the outer coat. Don't make the mistake of a single thick layer — you can't adjust the temperature. A quilted vest or a wool gilet between the shirt and the coat is the classic British solution, elegant and efficient.
Pantalonii plus-fours — cei care se term: Plus-fours — the trousers that end below the knee and fasten with a strap — are the authentic garment of British hunting. Pairing them with wool gaiters or tall woollen socks is both aesthetic and functional: it protects the leg from vegetation, provides warmth, and dries quickly. The modern alternative is straight trousers in tweed or moleskin, worn with tall boots.
Bocancii din piele cu talpă de cauciuc s: Leather boots with a rubber sole are the standard — waterproof, high-ankled, with good grip on wet terrain. Classic British brands like Dubarry, Hunter, or Le Chameau have built reputations over decades in the field. Avoid anything with a smooth sole or fine leather. A good boot is cared for with protective wax before every outing.
Căciula de tweed sau cloth cap este pies: The tweed cap or cloth cap is the centerpiece — it completes the ensemble and protects the head. Lined leather gloves are essential in cold months. A cashmere or merino wool scarf adds warmth and elegance. The leather or fabric cartridge bandolier, if worn visibly, must be of quality — it says as much about you as the coat does.
Harris Tweed autentic, lână tradițională: Authentic Harris Tweed, traditional wool, and field accessories. The pieces that define British tradition, available at Hunter House.
O experiență de croitorie personalizată,: A bespoke tailoring experience, in which every suit is created according to your measurements, style, and preferences. You choose the materials, details, and finishes, and we build a piece with an impeccable fit and a unique character.
Made to Measure nu este un costum dintr-: Made to Measure is not a suit off the rack, adjusted afterward. It is a suit built from scratch on your body's measurements — the shoulders, the chest, the waist, the hips, the arm length. Every element of the pattern is calibrated for your specific silhouette. The result is a fit that cannot be replicated by any off-the-rack suit, no matter how good it may be.
Totul începe cu o conversație Discutăm o: It all begins with a conversation. We discuss the occasion the suit is intended for, your visual style, your silhouette preferences — more structured or more relaxed, pleated or not, a single-breasted or double-breasted jacket. There is no wrong answer. The tailor listens and suggests, does not impose. In the end you have a clear direction before we touch any fabric.
Lucrăm cu stocuri din cele mai bune fila: We work with stocks from the finest European mills — Loro Piana, Scabal, Vitale Barberis Canonico, Holland & Sherry. Super 120s wool for versatility, Super 150s and cashmere for top occasions, tweed and flannel for the cold season or British style. We present the samples to you physically — the texture and the drape cannot be judged on a screen.
Luăm peste douăzeci de măsurători Tiparu: We take over twenty measurements. The pattern is built specifically for you, not adapted from a standard pattern. The hand-sewn interlining gives the jacket its structure — the shoulder falls naturally, the lapels roll without forcing.
A doua probă verifică ajustările și fini: The second fitting checks the adjustments and finishes. This is the moment for details — the exact sleeve length, the collar height, the lapel shape. Some suits require a third fitting if the silhouette or requirements are complex. We never deliver a suit that is not perfect — we prefer to postpone rather than compromise.
Un costum Made to Measure bine construit: A well-built Made to Measure suit lasts a decade or more if cared for properly. Storage on an anatomical hanger, dry cleaning at most once a year, regular brushing after wear. If your silhouette changes over time, the suit can be adjusted — precisely because it is built with extra material in reserve at the seams.
Peste douăzeci de măsurători Un singur c: Over twenty measurements. One single suit. Yours.
Prima întâlnire este fără obligații Îți: The first meeting is without obligation. We show you the atelier, the fabrics, and explain the process step by step.
Ziua nunții este singurul eveniment în c: Your wedding day is the one event where everyone is looking at you. A carefully created suit is not vanity — it is respect for the moment you are living.
Nunta ta definește registrul vestimentar: Your wedding defines the dress register. A classic religious event calls for a three-piece suit or even a morning coat; a garden ceremony allows a suit in a lighter cut, in light tones. The style chosen by the groom also dictates the recommendations for the best men and groomsmen — the visual coherence of the whole team is just as important as the central wearer.
Made to Measure vs Ready to Wear: Made to Measure vs. Ready to Wear
Dacă există un moment în viață care just: If there is one moment in life that justifies a suit created exclusively for your body, it is your wedding day. Made to Measure means every stitch thought out for your silhouette — the shoulder width, the sleeve length, the drape of the jacket. There is no compromise. Quality Ready to Wear, precisely adjusted by our tailor, remains an excellent option when time is limited.
Super 120s și Super 150s sunt standardul: Super 120s and Super 150s are the standard for a demanding wedding — they drape elegantly, don't wrinkle, and breathe well over the course of a long day. Navy and charcoal remain infallible classics. If the wedding is outdoors or in the warm season, a fine tweed or a light flannel adds character without sacrificing elegance. Pure white is for the dress — the groom prefers ivory, cream, or chalk.
Coerența nu înseamnă uniformitate Nașii: Coherence does not mean uniformity. The best men can wear the same suit in complementary colors, or the same fabric in slightly different cuts. The groomsmen coordinate with the groom, not with each other. A shared detail — the pocket square, the tie, or the shade of the suit — is enough to create a unified and refined image.
Cravata sau papionul este prima decizie: The tie or bow tie is the first decision. Next comes the pocket square — never identical to the tie, always complementary. Cufflinks with personal significance are a detail that stays in photographs for decades. The shoes — Oxford or Derby in black or dark brown, impeccably polished — complete the outfit. The watch, if you wear one, discreet and classic.
Recomandăm să programezi consultația cu: We recommend scheduling the consultation at least three months before the wedding. At Hunter House, the initial meeting is without obligation — we show you the fabrics, discuss style and proportions, and help you build an outfit that truly represents you. Final adjustments are made two weeks before the event.
Fiecare cusătură, gândită pentru corpul: Every stitch, thought out for your body.
